prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 40 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1399; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment grew to many times the usual amount for this injury, with near-daily visits and new body areas added weeks after the crash.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm a shoulder injury. No prior injury to this shoulder is known from the history obtained. Causal link to the collision is still under review, since the timing and pattern of symptoms do not yet settle whether the injury resulted from this event. Over the course of care, the patient attended 40 visits, with visits occurring nearly every day for a sustained period. Treatment also expanded to include additional body regions several weeks after the collision, which is well above the usual volume of care for this type of injury. Two similar charges recorded on the same day are currently being verified by the billing office. Plan going forward is to reassess functional status, reconsider the treatment frequency in light of clinical need, and document the findings for the records review.
